title: Synthesis, characterization, and α-glucosidase inhibitory activity of methyl proline derivatives of phenylpropanoid
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23208-23216
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02514E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Weiwei Zhang, Huiwen Yang, Xiangdi Yao, Ruipeng Li, Yao Yao, Wei Ma, Kailiang Ma, Lufei Shao, Pengjuan Zhou
Six proline-phenylpropanoid derivatives were synthesized, with 6f showing potent α-glucosidase inhibition (IC50 = 91 µM). Molecular docking revealed stable binding via π–π stacking and H-bonds, supported by DFT/ADME analyses.
